request.style: English, soul, female solo voice with warm backing choir, electric piano, double bass, drums, Hammond organ, hopeful and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I waited long for the Lord to hear
My cry went up through the heavy air
He bent down low to look at me
And answered what I was calling free

[Chorus]
He lifted me up out of the pit
From the clay where I was stuck in it
He set my feet upon a solid rock
And made my steps secure and strong

[Verse]
The mud held fast but he pulled me out
My fear was broken, my doubt removed
A new song rose within my mouth
To praise the God who made me found

[Chorus]
He lifted me up out of the pit
From the clay where I was stuck in it
He set my feet upon a solid rock
And made my steps secure and strong

[Verse]
Many will see and stand in awe
And put their trust in what he gave
Blessed is the one who trusts the Lord
Who turns away from the proud and bored

[Chorus]
He lifted me up out of the pit
From the clay where I was stuck in it
He set my feet upon a solid rock
And made my steps secure and strong

[Outro]
He lifted me up out of the pit
He made my steps secure and strong
